Name: Rizpah, Daughter of Aiah
Summary: Rizpah, daughter of Aiah and concubine of Saul, was the mother of Armoni and Mephibosheth. After her sons were hanged, she spread sackcloth on a rock and guarded their bodies from birds and beasts from harvest until rain fell, shaming David into burying Saul's house properly.
KeyStory: Rizpah guarded her hanged sons' bodies for months on a rock, until the king buried them.
RelatedPeople: King Saul; Armoni, Son of Saul; Mephibosheth, Son of Saul; Abner, Son of Ner
LifeLesson: A mother's vigil on a rock can move a king to do the just thing at last.
